CustomField.label: SAML Setting API Name
CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the Single Sign-On Setting (SAML) row in Setup for this org. Always populate for logging and CMDT validity; when Saml_Sso_Config_Id__c is blank, Apex also uses this value to query SamlSsoConfig (usually fails for Experience Guest — set Saml_Sso_Config_Id__c).
